# nomatron_job (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron application job by organization name, application slug, and exact job slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_job" "example" {
  org_name = "platform"
  app_slug = "payments"
  slug     = "web"
}

output "job_repository" {
  value = data.nomatron_job.example.effective_repo_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the job.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.
- `slug` (String) Exact job slug.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String) Optional cluster override for this job.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the job was created.
- `default_namespace` (String) Default Nomad namespace for this job.
- `description` (String) Job description.
- `effective_repo_url` (String) Repository URL Nomatron will use for this job after applying application-level inheritance.
- `id` (String) Job ID.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary job for the application.
- `jobspec_path` (String) Path to the job spec within the repository.
- `jobspec_type` (String) Job spec source type.
- `name` (String) Job display name.
- `repo_url` (String) Job-level repository override. Null means the job inherits the application repository.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the job was last updated.
